## Evidence Loop

| Step | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Observe | Several workflows execute tests or live checks while leaving no durable JSON evidence artifact. |

| Execute | Scan GitHub Actions workflows, classify evidence coverage, and require any executable workflow gap to be registered. |
| Evaluate | The verifier fails on unregistered executable workflows, stale generated docs, or unused accepted-gap entries. |
| Retrospective | The repository can now distinguish evidence-covered workflows from accepted debt and reduce the gap slice by slice. |
